 Shri Pradeep Singh Chouhan - Advocate for the Objector
 Order

This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.497/2024 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District-Betul for the offences punishable under Sections 294, 323, 506 and 376 of IPC and Section 3(1)(w)
(ii), 3(2)(VA) of SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.
Appellant is in jail since 06.08.2024.
As per the prosecution story, allegations against the present appellant is that he forcibly established physical relation with prosecutrix on the false pretext of marriage and also assaulted him.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that incident is said to have occurred on 30.04.2024 and FIR has been lodged on 10.05.2024.
There is NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45996 2 CRA-10140-2024 delay in lodging FIR for which no explanation has been furnished.
Prosecutrix as well as appellant are major.
It is a case of consent.
Appellant is in jail since 06.08.2024.
He further submits that trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the objector submits that appellant established physical relations with prosecutrix on the false pretext of marriage.
Further, it is also urged that on account of threat given by appellant, report could be lodged immediately.
On above grounds, it is urged that application filed by the appellant be dismissed.
Having regard to facts and circumstances of the case as well as evidence on record but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this appeal stands allowed.

It is directed that appellant-Mukesh Yadav be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-JBP:45996 3 CRA-10140-2024
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
